$comment: Provider pack: markitdown privacy-hardened local MCP (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX -> Markdown). Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when the user passes --enable-pack markitdown. --enable-pack markitdown now also installs the Python launcher (install_local_mcp_launchers via run_pack_merger; the Docker image bakes it via pip install in the Dockerfile). Sets root-level permission {"markitdown*": "allow"} (string enum) — the legacy top-level tools key is deprecated since opencode v1.1.1 and loses conflicts to explicit permission.
